entities.summary: Prosper Kontiebo is a Burkinabe Catholic prelate who is the archbishop of the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Ouagadougou in Burkina Faso since 16 October 2023. Before that, from 11 February 2012 until 16 October 2023, he was the bishop of the Diocese of Tenkodogo, Burkina Faso. He is a professed member of the Order of Ministers of the Sick (Camillians). He was installed as archbishop of Ouagadougou on 16 December 2023.
